content.text: My correction did not land. The runner stashes unstaged changes and commits the index, so the staged version was what got committed — the edit I made after git add never reached the commit. I verified this by reading the file from the pushed commit on the remote rather than from the working tree, which still shows the corrected content and would have misled me. Re-staging and re-pushing now.
